records.name: Epic Adventurez
records.summary: A live action roleplay group that plays cooperative stories together, with weekly play events and seasonal adventures. Members also learn acting, costume making, and prop building.
records.what_you_do: Play a character in cooperative games and stories, and help with costumes and props if you enjoy making things.

schedule.text: Weekly play events and seasonal adventures, according to the group's site

first_step.how: Click the Join us button on epicadventurez.org, then read the Programs page to pick a first event
first_step.basis: The site says it serves people who are new to live action roleplay and links its Join us button to a Programs page.

records.notes: Legal name Epic Adventurez. The .com address redirects permanently to .org, and the .org was used. The site shows no dated items, so probably_active rests on a working site with a join path, not a dated event. The site does not show a meeting place; the IRS address 210 N 60th St, 19139 is not confirmed on the site. The site links to Facebook, Instagram and Discord, which are not recorded here. The tabletop_rpg tag is the closest fit for live action roleplay.

records.name: Philly CoderDojo
records.summary: Free, volunteer-led coding clubs for young people ages 7 to 17. The clubs meet online in terms, and kids choose what they want to build while learning from each other and from mentors.
records.what_you_do: Kids bring their own ideas and work through them at their own pace with volunteer mentors. Adults can sign up to mentor after a short onboarding step.

schedule.text: Coding dojos run in terms over Zoom, and the site lists the 2025 to 2026 term

first_step.how: Parents or the young person fill in the student registration form linked as Dojo Registration on phillycoderdojo.com
first_step.basis: Anyone ages 7 to 17 can register through a public form, though the site does not say what a first session is like.

records.notes: Legal name Philly Coderdojo Inc. The dated items on the site are term labels, not full dates, and the footer copyright is not used as evidence. The site gives no street address, so the IRS address 5532 Pearl St, 19139 is not recorded. Status is probably_active rather than active because no month is given.

records.name: The PLUG
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that connects people with fewer resources to schooling, jobs, money skills, and wellness help. Its youth program, the Blueprint Social Development Institute, gives high school students mentors and a look at careers.
records.what_you_do: Teens in the Blueprint program learn career readiness, money skills, crisis mediation, and trade skills. Community members can ask to be connected to services through the Get Plugged In page.

first_step.how: Open the Get Plugged In page on theplugphilly.com and ask to be connected to a program
first_step.basis: The site names one sign-up page, but it does not say who qualifies or what happens next.

records.notes: Legal name Promoting Liberation to Under-Resourced Groups Incorporate. The site's Since 2023 line is not a dated event, so no sign-of-life month is recorded. Eligibility is not stated on the site, so none was inferred. Interests job_clubs and money_skills are the closest fits for the career and financial tracks.

records.name: Purple Eagle
records.summary: An education nonprofit that builds learning tools and makerspaces for K to 12 students. Its West Philadelphia makerspaces serve middle and high school students, and it is planning an online platform for school clubs.
records.what_you_do: Students work on making and learning projects in the West Philadelphia makerspaces. High school students also help design and test the planned online clubs platform.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us page on purpleeagle.org to ask how a middle or high school student can join a West Philadelphia makerspace
first_step.basis: The site names a contact page for the makerspaces but does not say how to sign up or what the process is.

records.notes: Legal name Purple Eagle. IRS data also lists the aka Purple Eagle Charitable Fund. The site describes a 501(c)(3) education nonprofit with operations in Philadelphia and Pittsburgh, so it was not treated as a private foundation. The newest dated items are planned items for 2025 and 2026 with no month, so status is an estimate. Verdict is publish because the site describes ongoing student makerspaces in West Philadelphia; the sign-up path is unknown.

records.name: Redemption Housing
records.summary: A faith-based group in Philadelphia that offers housing and support to people coming home from incarceration. Volunteers and faith partners help carry the work.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers can look at current openings on the group's Volunteer Opportunities page. People coming out of incarceration can apply for housing through the Resident Application page.

first_step.how: Volunteers: look at the Volunteer Opportunities page on redemptionhousing.org and reach out from there. Residents: start the Resident Application linked on the site.
first_step.basis: The volunteer page is public, but the newest dated news is from 2023, so check that openings are current before going.

records.notes: Newest dated items on the site: a board welcome dated July 2, 2023, and a director update dated September 15, 2022. Status is dormant under the 24 month rule. Kept as publish because the volunteer and resident pages are still listed. The IRS PO box is not recorded as a location because the site gives no street address. The phone number is the one published on the site for the director's contact line.

records.name: Society of Early Americanists
records.notes: A scholarly society for people who study American literature and culture to about 1830. The site names no Philadelphia meetings or programs, and its next conference is in Chicago in March 2027. The IRS lists a Locust Street address in Philadelphia, which the site does not confirm. The newest dated item is a featured scholar post dated July 10, 2026. Out of area.

records.name: 365 Brothers Foundation
records.summary: Men in family and community roles come together to care for neighborhoods. The group works to teach and encourage young people and local advocates about gun violence, schools, and neglected spaces.
records.what_you_do: Come to the group's public events (RSVP through the site) or support its work with a donation.

first_step.how: Use the RSVP link for the upcoming event on the group's homepage at 365brothersfoundation.org
first_step.basis: The site has an RSVP link, but no page explains how to join the network, and the event has no date on the page.

records.notes: The site text read does not name Philadelphia. The IRS address 953 N Fallon St, 19131 is in Philadelphia. The Get Involved page (page6.html) was linked but not fetched, so the join path is unverified. The Calendar page (page7.html) and the Season 5 flyer have no dates in their text. The community value men reflects how the site describes its network; the site does not say whether events are closed to others. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dated items.

records.name: Feed the Needy Association
records.notes: The website field held a city name, so it was treated as missing. One search returned only a third-party nonprofit profile on a banking and accounting platform. It matches this EIN (75-3111960) and Philadelphia, and gives a food-distribution purpose. It is not the group's own site and shows no dated activity, so no summary or categories are recorded. The same profile says the tax exemption was automatically revoked in May 2023 and reinstated in November 2024; that is unverified. The other results were a different group with the same name in Memphis. Retry to find the group's own site.

records.notes: The site shows only a Coming Soon placeholder. Its 2024 copyright footer is not dated activity. No program or public way in is visible, so it is hidden as private. The batch name has a spelling error (foundaiton).

leads_only.note: Named in a 6abc news report on West Philadelphia girls' athletics; it came up while searching for Girls Beyond the Clouds. The group's own site was not checked.

leads_only.note: Came up while searching for Girls Beyond the Clouds. Idealist is a lead-only source, so the listing was not read and the group's own site was not checked.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used (Girls Beyond the Clouds: no matching group; Feed the Needy Association: one third-party listing only). Fetches: 18 used, under the cap. No pages were blocked (no 403s or bot checks). Dead domains that did not resolve, even as bare domains: brighthopefamilyservices.org, elegancextremeevents.org, fearlessincons.com. Four groups were not searched because the search budget ran out: Bright Hope Family Services, Elegancextreme, Fearless Icons and Christian Services Association of Philadelphia; they are unknown records to retry next wave. Epic Adventurez: the .com address redirects permanently to .org, and the .org was used. Diamonds in the Ruff: its domain redirects to an unrelated domain (itubandot.com); the redirect was not followed, and the record needs a manual look. Several status values are estimates because the sources give only years, so no months were written for them.
